objects.name: imgproxy: Out-of-bounds heap read and write in ICO loader (CVE-2026-123615)
objects.description: imgproxy 3.3.0 before 4.0.17 contains an out-of-bounds heap read and write in the ICO loader's BMP header reconstruction (vips_foreign_load_ico_header in vips/icoload.c) when an ICO entry declares a tiny data size. This causes unvalidated header fields to be read and written past the allocated buffer. Unauthenticated remote attackers can supply a crafted ICO image to corrupt adjacent heap chunk metadata, triggering a glibc abort that crashes the worker.

objects.name: MIT Kerberos 5: GSS-RPC transport memory exhaustion (CVE-2026-112320)
Northflank environment variable compromise and AI API key abuse
objects.description:
## Overview
Northflank, a cloud application hosting provider, experienced a security breach in which unauthorized actors accessed customer account data. The attackers specifically targeted and exfiltrated environment variables, which included API keys for various AI services. These keys were subsequently used by threat actors to perform unauthorized computing tasks using customers' cloud-based AI resources, a technique referred to by researchers as 'LLMjacking'.

## Impact
The breach resulted in the compromise of sensitive customer environment variables and the theft of AI API keys. This enables unauthorized third parties to charge computing costs to the victims' accounts and potential access to underlying AI service platforms.

## Recommendation
- Rotate all API keys and secrets stored within Northflank environment variables immediately.
- Review AI provider billing logs and usage dashboards for spikes in activity or anomalous requests originating from IP addresses or locations not associated with your infrastructure.
- Implement tight access controls on API keys, utilizing scoping and restrictive usage limits where supported by the AI service provider.
- Audit current environment variable configurations to ensure no unnecessary sensitive credentials are stored in plain text or accessible via platform management interfaces.

objects.name: Modem Firmware: Remote privilege escalation via missing bounds check (CVE-2026-20554)
objects.description: CVE-2026-20554 identifies a vulnerability in the Modem due to a missing bounds check. A system crash or remote privilege escalation is possible if a user equipment (UE) device connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker. The issue requires no additional execution privileges but does require user interaction for exploitation. This issue is identified by Issue ID MSV-10122 and addressed by Patch ID MOLY01911177.

objects.name: libslirp: Denial of service in if_output (CVE-2026-120831)
objects.description:
## Overview
A vulnerability exists in the libslirp library within the `if_output()` function, identified as CVE-2026-120831. An attacker can trigger memory corruption when the library attempts to move a session from the fast queue to the batch queue. By unlinking and reinserting an arbitrary packet via `ifm->m_nextpkt` instead of the session queue head, the library corrupts internal queue pointers.

## Impact
Successful exploitation results in a crash of the host networking process, leading to a denial of service for the affected host. This impact is confirmed by the Red Hat bugzilla report.

## Recommendation
- Inventory systems utilizing libslirp, particularly virtual machine hosts or container runtimes relying on this user-mode networking library.
- Review the provided Red Hat Bugzilla report and Gitlab commit for patch availability or mitigating configuration changes.
- Prioritize patching for internet-facing or multi-tenant virtualization environments where an adjacent attacker could potentially reach the interface.

objects.name: ManageEngine Key Manager Plus SAML authentication bypass (CVE-2026-77800)
objects.description:
## Overview
ManageEngine Key Manager Plus versions before 7151 are vulnerable to a SAML authentication bypass flaw. The vulnerability allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access by submitting a valid SAML assertion intended for a different service provider to the Key Manager Plus application. This bypass circumvents standard authentication mechanisms.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the Key Manager Plus administrative interface.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade ManageEngine Key Manager Plus to version 7151 or later immediately to patch CVE-2026-77800.
- Review authentication logs for successful logins that originated from unusual sources or show inconsistencies in SAML assertion parameters if your environment utilizes SAML integration.

objects.name: Intelbras SG 2404 PoE L2+: Improper authentication in Web Management Interface (CVE-2026-124577)
objects.description:
## Overview
A critical improper authentication vulnerability exists in the Web Management Interface of the Intelbras SG 2404 PoE L2+ switch (firmware versions 1.00.70 and 1.00.72). The vulnerability resides in an unspecified function within the /EXCU_SHELL component and allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication. Public exploit code is available, heightening the risk of exploitation.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows for improper authentication, which may grant unauthorized access to the device management interface. Given the CVSS 9.8 score, this access can likely lead to full device compromise.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade Intelbras SG 2404 PoE L2+ firmware to version 1.00.74 or later immediately.
- Restrict access to the device web management interface to trusted internal networks only.
- Audit network logs for unauthorized access attempts targeting the /EXCU_SHELL path.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Authentication bypass via improper signature verification (CVE-2026-17301)
objects.description:
## Overview

IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 are susceptible to an authentication bypass vulnerability. This flaw arises from the improper verification of cryptographic signatures, which an unauthenticated attacker could potentially exploit to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized access to the application.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication, potentially resulting in unauthorized access to API management functions and sensitive data. The vulnerability is rated with a CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.8.

## Recommendation

- Inventory all instances of IBM API Connect within the environment to identify systems running the vulnerable version ranges (10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2).
- Review IBM security advisories for the release of security patches addressing CVE-2026-17301 and apply the appropriate update immediately upon availability.
- Monitor API gateway access logs for anomalous authentication patterns or requests targeting sensitive endpoints originating from unauthorized sources.

objects.name: AdaptixC2: New botnet command-and-control infrastructure
objects.description:
## Overview

ThreatFox has reported a new AdaptixC2 command-and-control (C2) node identified on 2026-11-04. The infrastructure facilitates botnet operations. As of this report, no specific exploit path or targeted product range is disclosed, but the threat is associated with the win.adaptix_c2 malware family.

## Recommendation

* Block all inbound and outbound traffic to the IP address 77.238.235.31 on port 10443 at the network perimeter.
* Hunt for internal network connections to the identified IP across firewall and proxy logs.
* Monitor host-based process telemetry for unexpected connections to external IPs using non-standard ports or associated with unrecognized processes.

objects.name: PostgreSQL: psqlODBC stack-based buffer overflow (CVE-2026-120061)
objects.description: The psqlODBC parser for ODBC escape sequences in application SQL text writes argument offsets of a {fn} escape into a fixed 16-entry stack array without bounds checking. Additionally, the parser does not initialize this array, allowing unsupplied arguments to copy arbitrary bytes into the query. Furthermore, the copy of a {d}, {t}, {ts}, or {escape} body writes one byte past a 128-byte stack buffer. Applications that forward untrusted SQL text to the driver expose their processes to memory corruption.

objects.name: MIT Kerberos 5: Memory exhaustion in AUTH_GSSAPI handler (CVE-2026-112321)
objects.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments on certain error paths. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger authentication failures. The CVSS v3.1 Base Score is 7.5.

objects.name: Modem: Remote privilege escalation via out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-20548)
objects.description: CVE-2026-20548 is an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the modem caused by an integer overflow. This vulnerability can lead to remote privilege escalation if a User Equipment (UE) connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker. No additional execution privileges or user interaction are required for exploitation. The issue is identified as MSV-9801, with patches MOLY01872867 and MOLY01774038.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Broken Object Level Authorization (CVE-2026-17293)
objects.description:
## Overview

IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 are susceptible to a Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-17293. The vulnerability exists because the application fails to perform adequate authorization checks when processing requests to modify user profile information. A remote authenticated attacker can manipulate API calls to target and alter profiles belonging to other users.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows a remote authenticated attacker to modify user profile data without proper authorization.

## Recommendation

- Audit internal API logs to identify any unauthorized attempts to access or modify user profile objects.
- Review IBM security bulletins for official patches or configuration mitigations.
- Apply the vendor-provided security updates to IBM API Connect immediately upon availability.

objects.name: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE: Buffer overflow in UploadCustomModule (CVE-2026-124060)
objects.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability was detected in the TOTOLINK CA300-PoE firmware version 6.2c.884. The issue resides in the UploadCustomModule function within the /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi file. The vulnerability can be triggered remotely by manipulating the 'File' argument. Public exploit information is available.

objects.name: FFmpeg: Heap buffer overflow in liboapve_encode (CVE-2026-125196)
objects.description: FFmpeg versions through 9.0.2 contain a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the `liboapve_encode()` function located in `libavcodec/liboapvenc.c`. The vulnerability is triggered when processing frames larger than the configured encoder dimensions. Attackers can craft video files with mid-stream resolution changes so that transcoding to APV without rescaling writes pixel data past the `imgb` plane buffers, resulting in heap memory corruption.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Arbitrary JavaScript execution and information disclosure (CVE-2026-17146)
objects.description: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a vulnerability (CVE-2026-17146) caused by improper input validation. This flaw could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript and obtain sensitive information.

objects.name: CPython: http.cookiejar deletes cookies of other domains via expired Set-Cookie (CVE-2026-124249)
objects.description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-124249) has been identified in the CPython `http.cookiejar` module. The module improperly handles expired `Set-Cookie` headers, resulting in the deletion of cookies associated with other domains.

objects.name: XunRuiCMS: Remote code injection via Mobile Site Directory (CVE-2026-120349)
objects.description: A security flaw has been discovered in dayrui XunRuiCMS up to 4.7.4. The function `str_replace` in the file `/var/www/html/zzmob/index.php` of the Mobile Site Directory component is affected. Manipulation of the `dirname` argument results in code injection. The attack can be launched remotely, and public exploit code is available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond.

objects.name: Logging Redactor: PII exposure in logs (CVE-2026-63417)
objects.description:
## Overview

Logging Redactor (loggingredactor) versions prior to 0.0.7 contain a vulnerability (CVE-2026-63417) where Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is not correctly redacted when processed by custom `__str__` and `__repr__` functions for non-primitive Python objects. This flaw causes sensitive information to be written to application log files in cleartext. There are no workarounds available for this vulnerability.

## Impact

Successful exploitation or accidental trigger of this vulnerability leads to the leakage of PII into application logs. This increases the risk of unauthorized access to sensitive data if log files are stored in insecure locations, exposed through log management systems, or accessible to unauthorized personnel.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade the `loggingredactor` package to version 0.0.7 or later across all applications and environments.
- Review existing application logs for potential historical PII exposure if the library was used to handle sensitive data.
- Rotate any credentials or secrets that may have been inadvertently logged while using affected versions of the library.

objects.name: ClearFake: New infrastructure identified for macOS payload delivery
objects.description:
## Overview

ThreatFox documented 35 new domains associated with the ClearFake campaign, a malware distribution network known for utilizing compromised websites and EtherHiding techniques to facilitate drive-by downloads. The newly identified infrastructure shows a targeted focus on macOS-based payloads, evidenced by associated naming conventions and metadata in the threat intelligence reporting.

## Impact

ClearFake campaigns utilize social engineering, often manifesting as fraudulent update prompts, to trick users into downloading malicious binaries. Observed activity primarily concerns payload delivery via drive-by download or deceptive landing pages.

## Recommendation

* Block the identified domains at the organization's DNS resolver and web proxy.
* Monitor EDR telemetry for browser-initiated downloads of suspicious DMG or PKG files, particularly from the newly identified infrastructure.
* Review web proxy logs for user traffic directed to the listed ".xyz", ".click", and ".store" domains.

objects.name: Craft CMS: Authorization bypass via GraphQL API (CVE-2026-124427)
objects.description:
## Overview
Craft CMS versions 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 are affected by an authorization bypass vulnerability in the GraphQL API. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to access entries that should be withheld by traversing the prev/next navigation fields. By chaining these queries, attackers can enumerate and extract data from private or out-of-scope sections, including titles, slugs, and custom field content.

## Impact
Unauthorized exposure of sensitive data stored in Craft CMS sections. Potential for full information disclosure of private entries.

## Recommendation
Upgrade Craft CMS to version 5.11.2 or later immediately to resolve the authorization logic flaw.

objects.name: BuddyForms: Privilege escalation via form submission (CVE-2026-107622)
objects.description:
## Overview

The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress (versions 2.10.5 and earlier) contains a critical privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper input validation and missing authorization checks. The plugin's public submission handler, `buddyforms_form_response_no_ajax()`, improperly trusts the `bf_post_type` parameter when handling new object creation. An unauthenticated attacker can supply a malicious form configuration via the `buddyforms_options` parameter to override the `new_user_role` setting. This allows an attacker to register a new account on a site where "Anyone can register" is enabled, granting that account administrator-level privileges.

## Attack Chain

1. Attacker identifies a WordPress site with the BuddyForms plugin and "Anyone can register" enabled.
2. Attacker crafts a POST request to the `buddyforms_form_response_no_ajax` handler.
3. Attacker specifies a malicious `bf_post_type` and injects an arbitrary form configuration via the `buddyforms_options` parameter.
4. The plugin fails to validate the request or verify authorization, permitting the creation of a rogue form entry in the global registry.
5. The rogue form is configured to assign the administrator role to new registrants via the `new_user_role` field.
6. Attacker submits a user registration through the newly created rogue form.
7. WordPress creates the account with administrative privileges, resulting in full site compromise.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated attacker to gain full administrative control over the WordPress site.

## Recommendation

* Immediately update the BuddyForms plugin to the latest patched version (post-2.10.5).
* If an update cannot be applied immediately, disable public registration on the WordPress site.
* Audit existing BuddyForms forms for unauthorized configuration changes or unexpected `new_user_role` values.
* Audit the WordPress user database for newly created administrator accounts.

objects.name: AWS EC2 snapshot permission modification
objects.description:
## Overview

Unauthorized modification of EC2 snapshot permissions, specifically using the 'ModifySnapshotAttribute' API call, can allow an attacker to share sensitive data with an external AWS account. This technique is often a precursor to data exfiltration in cloud environments.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows for the unauthorized copying of EBS volumes and the data contained within them to an adversary-controlled AWS account.

## Recommendation

Deploy the detection rule below to identify when snapshot attributes are modified. Audit IAM policies to restrict the 'ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute' permission to only authorized identity and access management (IAM) roles and users. Regularly review snapshots shared with external accounts via the 'DescribeSnapshotAttribute' API.

objects.name: Whitearmor Ransomware: Data Breach of AmplifAI GoDaddy Instance
objects.description:
## Overview
The Whitearmor ransomware group has claimed a successful breach of an AmplifAI instance used by GoDaddy. The actors exfiltrated a significant volume of data, including a database of 13,565 employees, operational rosters, and login logs detailing device usage and access locations. The leak confirms that the compromised instance is integrated with the GoDaddy Okta tenant, providing specific application IDs and federation metadata for Okta and Office 365. This presents a high risk of credential stuffing or session hijacking against the affected identity providers.

## Impact
The exfiltrated dataset contains sensitive employee information (names, emails, employee IDs, and password hashes/states) for over 13,500 individuals. Additionally, the exposure of Okta SSO and O365 federation parameters creates a direct risk for identity-based attacks targeting GoDaddy corporate systems.

## Recommendation
- Review Okta and Office 365 logs for anomalous access originating from accounts identified in the leaked database.
- Revoke and rotate credentials for any accounts found with non-default passwords in the leaked 'all_users.json' file.
- Monitor for unauthorized OIDC/SAML application access attempts utilizing the exfiltrated Application IDs (e.g., exksdlj2ty3Pfq9En0x7).
- Implement or enforce phishing-resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for the identified GoDaddy Okta tenant.

objects.name: Tencent Sogou Input Method DNS Hijacking and DarkVigil Deployment
objects.description: The threat actor SlippyNunchucks is conducting a surveillance campaign by hijacking DNS requests within the Sogou Input Method. The attack exploits insecure HTTP communications used by the application to fetch configurations, redirecting requests to actor-controlled staging servers. This process enables the deployment of the DarkVigil (FDMTP) backdoor via DLL sideloading using the legitimate component SGTool.exe. ESET identified this activity, noting that the campaign targets organizations and individuals across Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Vietnam, Oman, and Sri Lanka.

objects.name: smart-sso: Incorrect authorization in PermissionFilter (CVE-2026-121543)
objects.description:
## Overview
The PermissionFilter component in smart-sso up to version 2.0.1 fails to properly restrict access to administrative console APIs. Because the filter permits unlisted paths by default, any authenticated user can invoke sensitive administrative functions. An attacker can exploit this to perform actions such as calling '/admin/user-role/save' to assign themselves administrative privileges, reset passwords, or manage applications across integrated systems.

## Impact
Exploitation allows an authenticated user to achieve full administrative control over the smart-sso environment. This includes the ability to modify user roles, perform password resets, and gain management access to integrated systems linked to the SSO platform.

## Recommendation
- Update smart-sso to a version beyond 2.0.1 that addresses the permissive authorization logic in PermissionFilter.
- Audit access logs for unauthorized requests to the '/admin/' path hierarchy made by non-administrative user accounts.
- Configure the web server or application firewall to explicitly deny access to administrative API endpoints for all users except those assigned to the administrator role.

objects.name: Melapress Role Editor: Missing Authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-109899)
objects.description:
## Overview
A Missing Authorization vulnerability has been identified in Melapress Role Editor (melapress-role-editor). The vulnerability affects versions from n/a through 1.3.0 and allows for the exploitation of incorrectly configured access control security levels.

objects.name: PT Norther Lights Production MapSVG: Missing authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-123475)
objects.description: CVE-2026-123475 is a missing authorization vulnerability in the PT Norther Lights Production MapSVG mapsvg-lite-interactive-vector-maps plugin. This vulnerability allows for the exploitation of incorrectly configured access control security levels. This issue affects versions from n/a through 8.16.3.

objects.name: Perforce Puppet Server: Authorization bypass in trapperkeeper-authorization (CVE-2026-115732)
objects.description:
CVE-2026-115732 is an authorization bypass vulnerability affecting the trapperkeeper-authorization component used by Puppet Server. A client presenting a CA-signed certificate with a name that extends or shortens an authorized hostname can be incorrectly authorized as that host. 

Successful exploitation enables node impersonation. In Puppet Enterprise, this facilitates unauthorized access to certificate-authority administration and remote command execution on managed nodes. Exploitation requires a certificate with a colliding name, issued by the certificate authority via approval or autosign. A public Proof of Concept (PoC) is available on Sploitus.

objects.name: WP Inventory Manager: Reflected Cross-site Scripting (CVE-2026-111403)
objects.description:
## Overview

A vulnerability categorized as Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') exists in the WP Inventory Manager plugin for WordPress. This issue affects versions from n/a through 2.5.9 and allows for Reflected XSS.

objects.name: Kore: Integer underflow in HTTP request body handling (CVE-2026-121727)
objects.description: Kore before 4.3.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in HTTP request body handling that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass http_body_max by sending more body bytes than declared. Attackers can send oversized first segments over many concurrent POST, PUT or DELETE connections, wrapping content_length to grow buffers unbounded and exhaust worker memory.

objects.name: Videostrong Android device firmware backdoor (x.cpe)
objects.description:
## Overview
Google identified and disrupted a global botnet consisting of over 1.3 million infected Android devices, primarily TV set-top boxes, but also including telehealth devices, karaoke machines, and digital signage. The operation involved a persistent backdoor named x.cpe, which is embedded directly into the device firmware with system-level privileges. Google has confirmed that the manufacturer, Videostrong, intentionally implemented this backdoor, which was used to facilitate ad fraud and establish residential proxy networks. The backdoor can disable Google Play Protect, execute arbitrary commands, capture screens, and exfiltrate system data. Due to its firmware-level integration and use of manufacturer-signed system apps, the backdoor persists across factory resets.

## Attack Chain
1. Manufacturing: Videostrong embeds the x.cpe backdoor into device firmware during the production process.
2. Initial Access: The backdoor is pre-installed on devices distributed to consumers and organizations.
3. Evasion: Upon boot, the backdoor disables Google Play Protect to facilitate silent installation of malicious modules.
4. Command and Control: The backdoor contacts C2 servers, passing system information and awaiting instructions.
5. Exploitation: Remote operators deploy modules to the device, enabling residential proxy services or ad fraud operations.
6. Exfiltration: Operators capture screen content, keystrokes, and account details through remote shells or screen scraping.

## Impact
Over 1.3 million devices were confirmed to be part of the botnet, with infections detected across 206 models. The backdoor provides remote operators with full system access, allowing for the misuse of home internet bandwidth for residential proxy networks and unauthorized ad generation. The backdoor poses a persistent risk to corporate networks where these devices are connected, potentially serving as a pivot point.

## Recommendation
- Inventory all Android TV boxes and similar consumer IoT devices within your environment, specifically identifying those manufactured by or rebranded from Videostrong (e.g., MECOOL).
- Immediately isolate identified consumer Android devices from sensitive network segments or corporate infrastructure.
- Prioritize the replacement of devices identified as potentially infected, as firmware-level remediation is not feasible for the end-user.
- Implement network-level egress filtering to block traffic to known botnet control domains and IPs used by the x.cpe infrastructure.
- Treat all unmanaged consumer smart devices on home networks as untrusted; enforce the use of VPNs or managed endpoints for all corporate remote access.

objects.name: Agent Tesla: New indicators of compromise identified
objects.description:
## Overview
Twelve new Agent Tesla information stealer payloads were identified on 2026-11-04. Agent Tesla is a .NET-based malware family known for credential harvesting, keystroke logging, and clipboard exfiltration. These indicators are reported by the ThreatFox community and provide high-confidence artifacts for identifying recent infections.

## Impact
Confirmed impact includes the presence of unauthorized information stealer binaries on Windows systems. Possible impact includes credential theft, unauthorized access to sensitive accounts, and exfiltration of system data.

## Recommendation
- Implement file integrity monitoring or endpoint protection scans using the provided SHA-256 and MD5 hashes.
- Perform retrospective hunts in endpoint telemetry for the execution of files matching the reported hashes.
- Review network egress logs for connections to unauthorized C2 infrastructure often associated with Agent Tesla patterns.

objects.name: Crocoblock JetFormBuilder: Privilege escalation (CVE-2026-119481)
objects.description:
## Overview
Crocoblock JetFormBuilder is susceptible to a privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-119481) due to an incorrect privilege assignment flaw. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate their privileges within a WordPress environment. It affects all versions up to and including 3.6.7.1. A proof-of-concept exploit is publicly available.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated attacker to achieve high-level privileges, potentially leading to full compromise of the affected WordPress site, including confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact.

## Recommendation
- Update the JetFormBuilder plugin to a version beyond 3.6.7.1 as soon as a security update is released by the vendor.
- Audit WordPress user accounts for anomalous role changes or unauthorized administrative access.
- Restrict access to the WordPress administrative interface using IP allowlisting or VPNs where possible.

objects.name: HackTool: Default PowerSploit and Empire scheduled task persistence
objects.description:
## Overview

PowerSploit and Empire frameworks include modules for maintaining persistence on compromised Windows systems by creating scheduled tasks. These modules often employ default naming conventions and execution flags, specifically targeting task names like 'Updater' and executing PowerShell commands with non-interactive flags. This behavior is observable through process creation logs when `schtasks.exe` is spawned by `powershell.exe` or `pwsh.exe` with specific command-line arguments.

## Impact

Successful execution of these modules establishes persistence, allowing attackers to maintain access across system reboots or user logons without requiring manual re-exploitation.

## Recommendation

- Deploy the provided Sigma rule to detect the use of default persistence task creation patterns.
- Audit existing scheduled tasks for entries named 'Updater' that execute encoded or base-level PowerShell scripts.
- Review environment-wide use of `schtasks.exe` spawned by PowerShell to identify potentially unauthorized persistence mechanisms.

objects.name: Elastic: Machine learning detection for DNS-based Domain Generation Algorithms
objects.description:
## Overview

Elastic has released an updated machine learning-based detection rule designed to identify Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) activity within DNS traffic. DGA is a technique used by various malware families to generate large pools of domain names dynamically, allowing them to cycle through C2 infrastructure and evade static blocklist defenses. The detection relies on a supervised ML model to calculate a malicious probability score for DNS question names.

## Impact

The use of DGA allows malware to maintain communication with C2 servers even if individual domains are blocked or sinkholed. Monitoring for these patterns helps in early detection of C2 beaconing before a full-scale compromise or data exfiltration occurs.

## Recommendation

- Deploy the "Domain Generation Algorithm Detection" integration via Kibana to enable the required ML framework and ingest pipelines.
- Ingest DNS logs from Elastic Defend, Network Packet Capture, or Packetbeat into the Elastic Security platform.
- Tune the detection logic by adding exclusions for known internal development tools, software update mechanisms, and CDNs that frequently exhibit DGA-like naming patterns.
- Investigate high-scoring alerts by pivoting to endpoint logs on the source host to check for suspicious process activity associated with the DNS request.

objects.name: TrailBase: Insecure direct object reference in std.FileUpload (CVE-2026-119759)
objects.description: TrailBase 0.28.2 before 0.35.10 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to manipulate the object-store id metadata within std.FileUpload columns without ownership validation during insert and update operations. Attackers can reference another user's or table's file id in a record they own to read the victim's file bytes, trigger permanent deletion of the victim's file, or use a $like filter on the file column to brute-force recover stripped ids character by character.

objects.name: Mistral Vibe: Remote code execution via Git filter drivers (CVE-2026-122134)
objects.description:
## Overview

Mistral Vibe prior to version 2.25.7 contains a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-122134). The vulnerability originates in the ProjectContextProvider component, which automatically executes `git status` when a user opens a repository. An attacker can create a crafted Git repository containing malicious clean or process filter drivers. When a user opens this repository in Mistral Vibe, the application invokes these filters, leading to arbitrary code execution with the user privileges before any user trust prompts occur.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows for arbitrary code execution on the victim's machine under the context of the user account running Mistral Vibe.

## Recommendation

* Update Mistral Vibe to version 2.25.7 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.
* Implement endpoint policies to restrict the execution of Git processes from non-standard or untrusted directory structures if possible.
* Monitor for child processes spawned by Mistral Vibe or Git processes initiated from unusual project directories.

objects.name: The Grand Job WordPress plugin: Authentication bypass via password reset (CVE-2026-115237)
objects.description:
## Overview
The Grand Job WordPress plugin (versions 1.2.1 and earlier) fails to properly validate password reset codes during the password reset process. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to update the passwords of arbitrary user accounts, including those with administrative privileges, leading to full site takeover.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows for full site compromise by granting the attacker administrative control over the affected WordPress installation.

## Recommendation
- Inventory all WordPress instances utilizing "The Grand Job" plugin.
- Disable or remove the plugin until a patch is released by the developer.
- Audit administrative user account logs for unexpected password changes occurring since the discovery of this vulnerability.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Information disclosure via path validation (CVE-2026-16718)
objects.description: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 are affected by a vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper validation of file paths.

objects.name: Qihoo 360 Whole Home Router M5 hard-coded credentials (CVE-2026-121609)
objects.description: A vulnerability was identified in the Home function of the /etc/init.d/mpt file within the Boot Script component of the Qihoo 360 Whole Home Router M5 4.0.17.1566. This manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. The vulnerability allows for remote exploitation, and a public exploit is available. The vendor did not respond to disclosure attempts.

objects.name: Network UPS Tools: OS command injection in upsmon (CVE-2026-54161)
objects.description:
## Overview

Network UPS Tools (NUT) versions 2.8.3 through 2.8.5 are vulnerable to OS command injection within the upsmon component. The flaw exists in the way the notify(), async_notify(), and wall() functions handle the 'ups.alarm' value supplied by the UPS server. If an operator has configured 'NOTIFYCMD' with the 'EXEC' flag for 'NOTIFYFLAG ALARM', the application concatenates the server-supplied alarm text into a shell command. 

An attacker who can control the UPS device or compromise the upsd service, or perform a man-in-the-middle attack on a plaintext connection between upsd and upsmon, can inject shell metacharacters into the alarm value. This results in code execution with the privileges of the upsmon process, which is often configured as root. This vulnerability is fixed in version 2.8.6.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows for arbitrary operating-system command execution with the privileges of the upsmon process (commonly root). This provides an attacker with the ability to fully compromise the host system running the NUT client.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade Network UPS Tools to version 2.8.6 or later on all installations.
- Review upsmon configurations to identify instances where 'NOTIFYCMD' is utilized with the 'EXEC' flag for 'NOTIFYFLAG ALARM'.
- Ensure that connections between upsd and upsmon are encrypted using TLS to mitigate potential man-in-the-middle attacks, noting that this does not mitigate risks from an already compromised UPS device.

objects.name: Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7: Arbitrary file deletion (CVE-2026-102435)
objects.description: The Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the _getObjAttr function in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.54. Unauthenticated attackers can delete arbitrary files on the server when the PDF Generator add-on is active and a Contact Form 7 form is configured for PDF generation. This vulnerability may lead to remote code execution.

objects.name: Windows Code Integrity Policy Violations
objects.description:
## Overview

Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) and Code Integrity mechanisms monitor for unauthorized code execution. Event ID 3077 is generated when the system blocks an image or kernel-mode driver from loading because it does not meet the enforced policy signing level requirements or explicitly violates a configured Code Integrity policy. This telemetry is indicative of either misconfigured legitimate software, local policy conflicts, or attempts by an attacker to load unsigned or malicious drivers to gain kernel-level persistence.

## Recommendation

* Enable the "Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational" event log channel across all Windows endpoints to capture Event ID 3077.
* Investigate occurrences of Event ID 3077 to determine if the blocked file is a legitimate business application that requires an updated policy or a malicious attempt to load an unauthorized driver.
* Deploy the Sigma rule provided below to SIEM platforms to centralize monitoring of policy violations.

objects.name: WAVLINK WN553X1-B: OS command injection (CVE-2026-120231)
objects.description: A vulnerability (CVE-2026-120231) has been identified in WAVLINK WN553X1-B firmware version V260403_2.0.0. The flaw is located in the function 'sub_416568' of the file '/bin/ioos' within the OpenVPN CLI Handler component. Manipulation of the 'file_id' argument results in OS command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. Publicly disclosed exploit code exists and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early regarding this disclosure.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Cross-tenant sensitive information disclosure (CVE-2026-16854)
HPE Networking VIA: Command injection (CVE-2026-95727)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-95727 describes a command injection vulnerability in HPE Networking VIA. The vulnerability allows an authenticated administrative user to execute arbitrary commands with elevated privileges on the underlying operating system. No mitigation or fixed version is currently specified in the source.

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in arbitrary command execution on the host operating system with elevated privileges, potentially leading to full system compromise by an authenticated administrative user.

## Recommendation

1. Inventory all instances of HPE Networking VIA within the environment.
2. Implement strict access controls for administrative accounts to HPE Networking VIA to mitigate unauthorized access.
3. Monitor administrative logs for suspicious command execution or unexpected system modifications performed by accounts associated with the application.
4. Coordinate with HPE to determine the availability of security patches for this vulnerability.

objects.name: CFNext: Weak cryptographic derivation in subscription link (CVE-2026-121450)
objects.description:
## Overview

CFNext versions prior to 3.1.0 contain a vulnerability where the subscription UUID is generated using an MD5 hash of the administrator password combined with a static, public salt. This implementation allows unauthorized individuals possessing a valid subscription link to perform offline brute-force attacks to recover the cleartext administrator password. Successful exploitation grants full administrative access to the CFNext panel, allowing the retrieval of sensitive configuration secrets, including Trojan, Clash, Telegram, and Cloudflare API credentials.

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in full administrative compromise of the CFNext instance. Impact includes unauthorized access to system administration functions and the exposure of sensitive service credentials and proxy configuration secrets.

## Recommendation

* Upgrade CFNext to version 3.1.0 or later immediately to remediate the weak cryptographic derivation logic.
* Audit logs for administrative account activity from unrecognized IP addresses, specifically looking for repeated login attempts indicative of brute-forcing or credential stuffing.
* Rotate all API keys and credentials (Trojan, Clash, Telegram, Cloudflare) stored within the CFNext instance if evidence of unauthorized administrative access is detected.

objects.name: Nickboss WordPress File Upload: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (CVE-2026-66570)
objects.description: The WordPress File Upload plugin (wp-file-upload) by Nickboss is affected by a Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-66570. This issue is caused by the improper neutralization of input during web page generation and affects the plugin from version n/a through 5.2.1.

objects.name: Modem: Out of bounds write (CVE-2026-20545)
objects.description: CVE-2026-20545 is an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the modem caused by a missing bounds check. Exploitation can lead to remote escalation of privilege if a User Equipment (UE) connects to an attacker-controlled rogue base station. No additional execution privileges or user interaction are required for exploitation. The issue is tracked as MSV-9811, with patches identified as MOLY01879158 and MOLY01774038.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: SQL Injection (CVE-2026-17134)
objects.description: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands due to SQL injection. The vulnerability has a CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.9.

objects.name: MongoDB C Driver: GridFS file download API denial of service (CVE-2026-120955)
objects.description:
## Overview

The MongoDB C Driver contains a vulnerability in the GridFS file download API where the failure to check the result of internal operations during specific error conditions can lead to process termination. An attacker capable of manipulating file download parameters can induce this condition, causing a denial of service for applications utilizing the affected driver for GridFS operations. There is currently no mention of remote code execution or authentication bypass; the impact is limited to service availability.

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in the termination of the process utilizing the affected MongoDB C Driver API, leading to denial-of-service for the dependent application.

## Recommendation

1. Inventory all applications currently utilizing the MongoDB C Driver.
2. Monitor for application-level crashes or service restarts occurring during GridFS file retrieval operations.
3. Apply patches or updates to the MongoDB C Driver once a remediated version is released by the vendor.

objects.name: OpenEMR: Broken object-level authorization in SOAP note API (CVE-2026-124473)
objects.description:
## Overview

OpenEMR versions prior to 8.3.0 contain a broken object-level authorization (BOLA) vulnerability in the SOAP note update API. The application fails to verify that the provided SOAP note ID (sid) is associated with the patient and encounter specified in the request URI. An authenticated user with existing "encounters/notes" permissions can perform a PUT request to the API, allowing them to overwrite existing clinical notes and reassign the records to a different patient ID.

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in unauthorized modification of clinical records and data integrity compromise within the electronic medical record system. 

## Recommendation

* Upgrade OpenEMR to version 8.3.0 or later to resolve the underlying authorization logic flaw.
* Audit web server logs for PUT requests to the SOAP note API where the requested Patient ID (pid) or Encounter ID (eid) may be inconsistent with access patterns or user-specific permissions.
* Review access control logs for users with "encounters/notes" permissions to identify anomalous update activity.

objects.name: Keycloak: Dynamic Client Registration identity forgery (CVE-2026-92857)
objects.description: CVE-2026-92857 is a vulnerability in the Dynamic Client Registration feature of Keycloak. A flaw in how Keycloak validates registration requests allows an attacker with specific tokens to create a malicious application that forges identity information. By mapping user profile details to protected fields like the user ID (sub) or intended audience (aud), an attacker can generate signed security tokens to impersonate other users or gain unauthorized access to services relying on these tokens.

objects.name: Credential Dumping via LSASS Process Access
objects.description:
## Overview

Credential dumping tools frequently target the Windows LSASS process to extract plaintext passwords, NTLM hashes, or Kerberos tickets from memory. This activity typically involves opening a handle to lsass.exe with specific access masks to read memory segments, often utilizing legitimate system libraries like dbghelp.dll or dbgcore.dll. This behavior is commonly observed in tools such as Mimikatz, NanoDump, Invoke-Mimikatz, and Procdump, as well as the native Task Manager "Create dump file" feature.

## Impact

Successful credential dumping allows attackers to harvest credentials from memory, facilitating lateral movement, privilege escalation, and persistence within the environment.

## Recommendation

* Deploy the detection rule below to identify suspicious handles being requested for the LSASS process.
* Baseline legitimate administrative activity or security tooling that may trigger this rule, such as legitimate memory diagnostics or authorized security scanners, to tune out false positives.
* Enable Sysmon process access logging (Event ID 10) to capture the necessary GrantedAccess and CallTrace telemetry.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Remote authenticated privilege escalation (CVE-2026-17158)
objects.description: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 are susceptible to a remote authenticated privilege escalation vulnerability (CVE-2026-17158) due to improper authentication.

objects.name: Linux Kernel: TIPC Subsystem Use-After-Free (CVE-2026-99246)
objects.description:
## Overview

The Linux kernel TIPC (Transparent Inter Process Communication) subsystem contains a use-after-free vulnerability (CVE-2026-99246) caused by improper locking during the `tipc_node_reset_links` trace event. The vulnerability arises because the trace event executes without holding the node lock, allowing a link to be freed by a concurrent bearer teardown process while the trace callback is attempting to dump the link. This race condition results in a memory corruption scenario as `tipc_link_dump()` dereferences a stale pointer.

## Impact

The vulnerability allows an unprivileged local attacker or a process with sufficient privileges to interact with the TIPC subsystem to trigger a use-after-free condition. This likely results in a kernel panic or system crash (Denial of Service). There is no confirmed evidence of remote exploitation or privilege escalation, though memory corruption bugs can occasionally be leveraged for such purposes in specialized environments.

## Recommendation

Update the Linux kernel to a version containing the fix for CVE-2026-99246. As the vulnerability requires specific race conditions within the TIPC subsystem, systems that do not utilize TIPC may reduce their attack surface by disabling the module (e.g., via `modprobe -r tipc` or blacklisting).

objects.name: VitaFit cloud API: Unauthenticated access via cloud storage misconfiguration (CVE-2026-54381)
objects.description:
## Overview

VitaFit cloud API versions released prior to 2026-10-30 contained a cloud storage bucket misconfiguration. This vulnerability permitted unauthenticated attackers to perform directory listing and file retrieval operations against the bucket without requiring valid authentication credentials. The misconfiguration exposed 129,947 objects, including 126,881 user-uploaded profile images, potentially leaking sensitive personal information.

## Impact

The vulnerability allowed unauthorized access to 129,947 total objects within the misconfigured storage bucket. Verified exposure includes the unauthorized retrieval of 126,881 user-uploaded profile images.

## Recommendation

* Verify that all cloud storage buckets associated with the VitaFit environment have been audited for public read/list permissions as of 2026-10-30.
* Review cloud provider audit logs (e.g., AWS CloudTrail, GCP Cloud Audit Logs, or Azure Monitor) for high volumes of "ListBucket" or "GetObject" API requests originating from unauthorized or anomalous IP addresses to detect potential data exfiltration.

objects.name: Apache ActiveMQ: LDAPAuthorizationMap authorization bypass (CVE-2026-108500)
objects.description:
## Overview

Apache ActiveMQ is vulnerable to an authorization bypass issue (CVE-2026-108500) within the LDAPAuthorizationMapPlugin. An authenticated attacker can exploit this by creating or addressing a message destination using a name containing specific LDAP Distinguished Name (DN) special characters, such as commas, plus signs, equals signs, or backslashes. This allows the attacker to circumvent established authorization policies, potentially accessing or creating destinations they are not permitted to manage.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an authenticated attacker to bypass authorization constraints within the broker, leading to unauthorized message destination creation or access.

## Recommendation

* Identify and inventory all Apache ActiveMQ instances running affected versions (6.3.0 through 6.3.2, or 5.19.0 through 5.19.11).
* Upgrade Apache ActiveMQ 6.3.x instances to version 6.3.3 or later.
* Upgrade Apache ActiveMQ 5.19.x instances to version 5.19.12 or later.
* Review ActiveMQ audit logs for unexpected creation or interaction with destinations containing LDAP special characters (e.g., symbols like '+' or ',').

objects.name: D-Link DIR-505: Stack-based buffer overflow in TFTP Upload Filename Handler (CVE-2026-120189)
objects.description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. The affected functions are `save_upload_file`/`mp_upload_file` located in `/usr/bin/tftpd`, part of the TFTP Upload Filename Handler component. This manipulation leads to a stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be carried out remotely. Publicly available exploit code exists.

objects.name: IBM Langflow OSS: Arbitrary file read and write vulnerability (CVE-2026-97677)
objects.description: IBM Langflow OSS versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.2 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated flow author can bypass platform file isolation. This allows an attacker to write arbitrary content to any directory writable by the service account. Additionally, by using a crafted on-disk index, an attacker can read arbitrary files accessible to the service process, including configuration files, secrets, and database files.

objects.name: BTCPay Server: LND node macaroon information disclosure (CVE-2026-119757)
objects.description:
## Overview

BTCPay Server versions prior to 2.4.2, including 2.4.2 release candidates, are susceptible to an information disclosure vulnerability. The flaw permits an unauthenticated remote attacker to retrieve '.macaroon' credential files utilized by the Lightning Network Daemon (LND).

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in full administrative control over the affected LND node. Attackers may perform unauthorized operations, including the movement and theft of funds from the affected Lightning node deployments.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade BTCPay Server to version 2.4.2 or later immediately to remediate the vulnerability.
- Audit LND node configurations for unauthorized access or unexpected changes in node management patterns if the instance was exposed to the internet.
- Review network access controls to ensure the BTCPay Server management interface is not accessible to untrusted network segments.

objects.name: Wpmet Wp Social: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CVE-2026-122675)
objects.description:
## Overview

The Wp Social plugin for WordPress contains a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability (CVE-2026-122675). The vulnerability exists within the `Admin_Settings::content_xs_providers()` function in `inc/admin-settings.php`. The plugin fails to perform a nonce or referer check when processing the `xs_provider_submit_form` POST request. This flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to manipulate social login provider settings, specifically the OAuth client ID and client secret, if an administrator with an active session is lured to a malicious page.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an attacker to overwrite site-wide social login provider settings. This can lead to the redirection of OAuth authentication flows to attacker-controlled services, potentially facilitating unauthorized access or account takeover scenarios for users authenticating via social login providers.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade the Wp Social plugin to version 3.2.4 or later immediately.
- Audit the `xs_provider_data` option in the WordPress database for unauthorized changes to OAuth client credentials.
- Advise administrative users to avoid browsing untrusted websites while authenticated to the WordPress dashboard.

objects.name: PostgreSQL: psqlODBC heap buffer overflow (CVE-2026-120058)
objects.description:
## Overview
The psqlODBC driver sizes its row cache based on the column count of a cursor's first result. It fails to verify that subsequent FETCH replies match this count, allowing an untrusted server to trigger heap-based buffer overflows by providing a higher column count. Additionally, a keyset reply with fewer columns than the key fields can cause an unsigned integer underflow. These issues are reachable when UseDeclareFetch is enabled. Versions before psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

objects.name: Ghost RAT Indicator Update
objects.description: On 2026-11-04, ThreatFox identified one new indicator of compromise (IOC) associated with the Ghost RAT (win.ghost_rat) malware family.

objects.name: C-Prot AppDefense: Improperly controlled modification of dynamically-determined object attributes (CVE-2026-95648)
objects.description: C-Prot AppDefense is affected by an improperly controlled modification of dynamically-determined object attributes vulnerability, which allows for privilege escalation. This issue affects C-Prot AppDefense versions before 1.0.2729.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: SSRF information disclosure and security bypass (CVE-2026-17353)
objects.description: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information and bypass security restrictions due to server-side request forgery.

objects.name: OpenBMB Internet of Agents: Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-123032)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-123032 describes an authentication bypass vulnerability within the ConnectionManager.connect function of the im_server/app.py file in the OpenBMB Internet of Agents WebSocket Connection Manager. An unauthenticated attacker can remotely manipulate the agent_name argument to circumvent authentication mechanisms. Public exploit code is available for this vulnerability. As the project uses a rolling release model, no specific version numbers are provided; all instances up to commit hash 9d78e88e47160eb42ee1ee8538c05e1c2c47877a are considered affected.

## Impact

The vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to establish connections to the server without proper authentication, potentially leading to unauthorized access to agent infrastructure or control functionality.

## Recommendation

- Monitor websocket connection logs for anomalous agent_name values or unexpected connection patterns from external, unauthenticated sources.
- Audit the project repository for updates or patches, as the maintainers have not yet responded to the reported vulnerability.
- Implement network-level restrictions or authentication proxies in front of the Internet of Agents server to limit exposure until a permanent patch is integrated into the rolling release.

objects.name: Xen Hypervisor: Multiple security vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-100080, CVE-2026-100081, CVE-2026-100082)
objects.description:
## Overview

The Xen Project has released security advisories (XSA-526, XSA-527, XSA-528) addressing multiple vulnerabilities affecting all versions of the Xen hypervisor prior to the latest security updates. These flaws can lead to privilege escalation, unauthorized access to sensitive information, and denial-of-service conditions. No technical details on exploitation vectors are currently disclosed; administrators should apply the patches referenced in the official advisories immediately.

## Impact

The identified vulnerabilities can result in privilege escalation, compromise of data confidentiality, and system-wide denial-of-service attacks.

## Recommendation

- Inventory all systems running the Xen hypervisor.
- Review the official Xen security advisories for XSA-526, XSA-527, and XSA-528 to identify affected versions within the environment.
- Apply security patches provided by the distribution vendor or the Xen project immediately.

objects.name: WAVLINK WN536AX6-A: Remote command injection (CVE-2026-120276)
objects.description: A weakness has been identified in the Web Management Interface of the WAVLINK WN536AX6-A (version V260507_2.0.0). The vulnerability resides in function 'sub_416760' of the file '/bin/ioos'. Manipulation of the 'group_name' argument allows for remote OS command injection. Public exploit code is available for this vulnerability. The vendor was contacted early regarding this disclosure.

objects.name: imgproxy: Heap buffer overflow in ICO loader (CVE-2026-123614)
objects.description:
## Overview
imgproxy versions 4.0.0 to 4.0.15 are affected by an integer overflow vulnerability in the ICO image loader component. An attacker can craft an ICO image with a specifically manipulated data_size parameter. When processed by the application, this value triggers an integer overflow in the memory allocation logic within the vips/icoload.c source file. This results in a heap buffer overflow, which can be leveraged to crash the service (Denial of Service) or execute arbitrary code.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to cause a process crash or potentially achieve remote code execution on the server running imgproxy.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade imgproxy to version 4.0.16 or later immediately.
- Audit logs for repeated crashes or unusual memory spikes associated with the imgproxy service, which may indicate exploitation attempts.

objects.name: Label Studio: Server-side request forgery (CVE-2026-121561)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-121561 affects Label Studio (< 1.23.2) and label-studio-sdk (< 2.1.2). The vulnerability allows an authenticated attacker to perform server-side request forgery (SSRF). By importing tasks with a crafted 'data.image' field, an attacker can coerce the Label Studio server into making unauthorized requests to internal network services. Exporting these tasks via YOLO or COCO formats allows the attacker to retrieve internal service responses, potentially leading to the theft of organization owner API tokens through Host header manipulation.

## Attack Chain

1. Attacker authenticates to the Label Studio platform.
2. Attacker submits a task containing a 'data.image' URL pointing to a targeted internal service.
3. Label Studio server processes the image metadata from the task.
4. Attacker initiates an export request using the YOLO or COCO format.
5. The server performs an SSRF request to the internal URL provided in the task metadata.
6. Attacker retrieves the exported file, which includes the response body from the internal service or captured API tokens.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade Label Studio to version 1.23.2 or later immediately.
- Upgrade label-studio-sdk to version 2.1.2 or later.
- Audit outbound network egress from Label Studio servers to limit access to sensitive internal infrastructure.

objects.name: SUSE Linux Kernel Multiple Vulnerabilities
objects.description:
## Overview

The French National Cybersecurity Agency (ANSSI) has published an advisory regarding multiple vulnerabilities identified in the SUSE Linux kernel. These security flaws impact a wide range of SUSE products and modules, including SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES), openSUSE Leap, and SUSE Linux Micro. Confirmed impacts include potential data confidentiality breaches, security policy bypasses, and denial-of-service conditions. SUSE has released a series of security bulletins (SUSE-SU-2026:XXXX) to address these issues.

## Impact

Successful exploitation of these kernel vulnerabilities may lead to:
- Unauthorized access to sensitive data (confidentiality breach).
- Circumvention of established system security policies.
- System instability or crash (denial-of-service).

## Recommendation

1. Inventory all assets running SUSE Linux distributions, specifically checking for the versions listed in the affected products section.
2. Review the specific security bulletins referenced in the source documentation to identify required patch levels.
3. Prioritize patching internet-facing systems and high-availability clusters to prevent potential remote exploitation.
4. Coordinate with IT operations to perform testing and deployment of the SUSE kernel updates provided in the bulletins.

objects.name: Bashlite Botnet: New IoT Payload Delivery Infrastructure
objects.description:
## Overview

Abuse.ch has identified 14 new malicious URLs linked to the Bashlite (also known as Gafgyt) IoT botnet. These indicators, observed on 2026-11-04, point to binary payloads tailored for multiple CPU architectures, including ARM, MIPS, PowerPC, SPARC, and x86_64. The infrastructure is centralized on the IP address 181.214.147.11.

## Impact

The identified indicators represent active payload delivery vectors. Bashlite typically targets internet-exposed IoT devices to incorporate them into botnets for distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) operations.

## Recommendation

- Block all ingress and egress traffic to/from the IP address 181.214.147.11 at the perimeter firewall and web proxy.
- Audit network logs for any successful HTTP GET requests to the identified URLs, as these indicate potential device infection.
- Implement outbound traffic filtering to prevent IoT devices from downloading arbitrary binaries from unknown external web servers.

objects.name: Linksys E5600 Out-of-Bounds Write (CVE-2026-121617)
objects.description: A security flaw (CVE-2026-121617) exists in Linksys E5600 1.1.0.26. The vulnerability affects the init_multipart function of the /cgi-bin/upload_fw.cgi file in the Header Parser component. The manipulation results in an out-of-bounds write. The attack may be launched remotely. Public exploit code is available. The vendor was contacted but did not respond. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

objects.name: esm.sh: web.NewHandler arbitrary file read via encoded dot-segment path traversal (CVE-2026-102657)
objects.description:
## Overview

The `web.NewHandler` component in `esm.sh/web` (versions < 0.2.0) contains a path traversal vulnerability. When a request path contains URL-encoded dot-segments (e.g., `%2e%2e`), Go's `ServeMux` fails to redirect the request, and the handler proceeds to join the decoded path with `AppDir` without performing a containment check. This allows unauthenticated attackers to read files located outside the intended application directory, restricted only by the filesystem permissions of the server process.

## Attack Chain

1. Attacker crafts an HTTP GET request containing URL-encoded traversal segments (e.g., `/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/secret.txt`).
2. The network-facing `http.ServeMux` decodes the request path.
3. Because the segments are URL-encoded, `ServeMux` does not block or redirect the request.
4. The request is passed to `web.NewHandler`.
5. `web.NewHandler` joins the `Config.AppDir` path with the decoded `r.URL.Path`.
6. The application performs `os.Lstat` and `os.Open` on the resulting path, which resolves to a location outside the application directory.
7. The server reads the file content and copies it into the HTTP response body, disclosing sensitive data to the attacker.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files on the filesystem accessible to the application process. This may include configuration files, environment variables, source code, or private keys, depending on the server configuration and file permissions.

## Recommendation

1. Upgrade `esm.sh/web` to version 0.2.0 or later immediately.
2. For environments where upgrading is delayed, apply input validation at the web server or proxy level to block request paths containing `%2e` or `..` segments.
3. Ensure the web application runs with the principle of least privilege, restricting the filesystem access of the process to the absolute minimum required by `AppDir`.

objects.name: GS JWT: Unauthenticated SQL injection and admin JWT forgery (CVE-2026-113615)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-113615 is a critical SQL injection vulnerability in the GS JWT WordPress plugin. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this via the `/wp-json/gs-jwt/v1/verify-otp` endpoint to forge a server-signed JSON Web Token (JWT). This token grants the attacker administrative privileges, enabling them to register new, persistent administrator accounts via the WordPress REST API. Publicly available exploit modules confirm the ease of exploitation.

## Attack Chain

1. Attacker identifies a target running the vulnerable GS JWT plugin.
2. Attacker sends a malicious POST request to the `/wp-json/gs-jwt/v1/verify-otp` endpoint.
3. SQL injection payload is processed by the plugin to forge a valid administrator JWT.
4. Attacker receives the forged JWT and uses it in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
5. Attacker authenticates to the WordPress REST API as an administrator.
6. Attacker optionally invokes the `/wp/v2/users` endpoint to create a new persistent administrator account.

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in full administrative control over the WordPress instance. This includes the ability to modify site content, install malicious plugins, exfiltrate data, and create persistent backdoors via new administrative users.

## Recommendation

- Immediately audit WordPress installations for the presence of the GS JWT plugin.
- Update the GS JWT plugin to a patched version if available; otherwise, disable or remove the plugin until a patch is applied.
- Review WordPress user lists for unauthorized administrative accounts created or modified since the vulnerability's discovery.
- Implement strict rate-limiting on the `/wp-json/gs-jwt/v1/verify-otp` endpoint to mitigate automated exploitation attempts.

objects.name: Webmin: OS command injection in samba/save_euser.cgi (CVE-2026-125391)
objects.description:
## Overview
Webmin versions through 2.670 are vulnerable to OS command injection within the `samba/save_euser.cgi` script. The vulnerability stems from the insufficient validation of the `opts` parameter. Authenticated users with permissions to manage Samba users can inject shell metacharacters into the account option flags processed by `create_user` and `modify_user` functions, leading to command execution with root privileges.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying host operating system with root-level privileges.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade Webmin to a version beyond 2.670 once a vendor security patch is available.
- Audit administrative access to the Webmin Samba module to restrict it to trusted administrative accounts.
- Implement the suggested hunt lead to monitor for suspicious command execution originating from the Webmin process context.

objects.name: Whale Browser: Iframe sandbox bypass (CVE-2026-120987)
objects.description: Whale Browser before 5.39.412.57 contains a vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the iframe sandbox in a dual-tab environment.

objects.name: JeecgBoot JimuBI: SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-124554)
objects.description: A security flaw has been discovered in JeecgBoot 3.9.5 affecting the component JimuBI, specifically the file /jeecg-boot/drag/onlDragDatasetHead/getAllChartData. Manipulation of the 'params' argument results in SQL injection. Remote exploitation is possible, and public exploit code has been released. The vendor was contacted but did not respond.

objects.name: IBM Security Verify Directory: Session Fixation (CVE-2026-8639)
objects.description: IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and 11.0.0 are vulnerable to session fixation. An attacker with low privileges can establish a session and, after the victim authenticates, hijack the authenticated session to gain unauthorized access to the directory management console. A public proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for this vulnerability is available on Sploitus.

objects.name: ChatCLI: Improper validation in MCP OAuth login flow (CVE-2026-123271)
objects.description:
## Overview

ChatCLI versions before 1.215.2 contain an improper validation vulnerability in the Model Context Protocol (MCP) OAuth login flow. The application uses server-supplied Protected Resource Metadata as a resource indicator without verifying that it matches the locally configured server URL. An attacker operating a malicious MCP server can cause the application to request an OAuth bearer token for a different, potentially sensitive resource hosted on the same authorization server and subsequently replay that token to impersonate the user against that resource.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows a malicious MCP server operator to obtain valid OAuth bearer tokens intended for different resources, leading to unauthorized access and user impersonation within the context of the shared authorization server.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade ChatCLI to version 1.215.2 or later immediately to patch the validation logic flaw.
- Review OAuth authorization server logs for unusual token request patterns originating from MCP clients.
- In environments where upgrading is delayed, limit the use of MCP servers to trusted and verified sources.

objects.name: IBM API Connect: Arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability (CVE-2026-16714)
objects.description:
## Overview

IBM API Connect contains a path traversal vulnerability in specific versions (10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2). This flaw allows a remote attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the underlying file system. No exploit path or proof-of-concept is currently documented by the source.

## Recommendation

- Audit all internet-facing instances of IBM API Connect to identify versions within the 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 ranges.
- Review official vendor security advisories from IBM for patch availability and apply the corresponding update to the affected API Connect components.
- Monitor web server access logs for anomalous directory traversal patterns, such as sequences including '../', '%2e%2e/', or equivalent encoding, targeted at API management endpoints.

objects.name: IBM Optim: Path traversal information disclosure (CVE-2026-17466)
objects.description:
## Overview

IBM Optim versions 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 contain a path traversal vulnerability. An authenticated attacker can leverage this flaw to access sensitive files on the underlying host system, leading to unauthorized information disclosure. No specific patch information is provided in the initial advisory; users should monitor IBM security updates for remediation guidance.

## Impact

The vulnerability is rated with a CVSS v3.1 score of 9.1. Successful exploitation allows an authenticated attacker to read arbitrary files from the filesystem accessible to the application process, potentially exposing credentials, configuration data, or system-level information.

## Recommendation

- Identify all instances of IBM Optim 1.0.0, 1.1.0, and 1.2.0 within the environment.
- Monitor IBM official security bulletins for the release of security patches addressing CVE-2026-17466.
- Until a patch is applied, restrict access to the IBM Optim management interface to authorized, known administrative subnets only.
- Review application access logs for repeated file access requests containing directory traversal sequences (e.g., "../", "..\\").

objects.name: Trezor: Warning regarding suspected crypto-theft hardware implant
objects.description: Trezor has issued a public warning concerning a suspected hardware implant in their cryptocurrency wallet devices. The report indicates that the implant is suspected of being used to facilitate the theft of cryptocurrency assets.

objects.name: Raven Stealer malware distribution
objects.description:
## Overview
Abuse.ch ThreatFox reported 12 new samples of the Raven Stealer malware on November 4, 2026. These indicators represent newly identified malicious payloads currently associated with the Raven Stealer operation.

## Recommendation
- Block the SHA-256 and MD5 hashes listed in this brief at the enterprise perimeter and endpoint security solutions.
- Implement file integrity monitoring and endpoint detection to identify execution attempts of these hashes.
- Scan historical logs for the presence of these indicators to identify potential prior compromise.

objects.name: weDevs weDocs: Missing authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-121760)
objects.description:
## Overview
The weDevs weDocs plugin, from version n/a through 2.6.1, is affected by a Missing Authorization vulnerability. This flaw allows for the exploitation of incorrectly configured access control security levels.

objects.name: Mattermost Server: Multiple Security Vulnerabilities
objects.description:
## Overview

The French National Cybersecurity Agency (ANSSI) has issued an advisory regarding multiple vulnerabilities in Mattermost Server. These issues were disclosed in Mattermost security bulletins MMSA-2026-00592, MMSA-2026-00781, and MMSA-2026-00786. The vendor has not provided specific details regarding the nature of the vulnerabilities or their potential impact.

## Recommendation

- Inventory all deployed Mattermost Server instances to identify affected versions.
- Upgrade Mattermost Server instances to the latest secure versions as defined by the vendor security bulletins.
- Monitor the official Mattermost security updates page for additional technical details as they become available.

objects.name: FFmpeg: Heap out-of-bounds write in Vulkan AV1 decoder (CVE-2026-125201)
objects.description: FFmpeg 7.0 before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in `vk_av1_decode_slice()` in `libavcodec/vulkan_av1.c`. The vulnerability occurs because the tile-count limit is checked only on entry. Attackers can supply a crafted AV1 stream with more than 256 tiles decoded via the Vulkan hardware accelerator to overflow `tile_sizes` and corrupt heap memory.

objects.name: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway: Arbitrary file manipulation via Large File Transfer (CVE-2026-114425)
objects.description:
## Overview

SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway versions before 15.1.1 are susceptible to unauthenticated arbitrary file read, move, or delete attacks. The vulnerability exists within the Large File Transfer (LFT) feature, which incorrectly trusts externally provided file path metadata. Attackers can leverage this to manipulate files processed by the mail-worker, which executes with root privileges. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-114425.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to read, move, or delete arbitrary files on the system with root-level privileges, potentially leading to full system compromise or information disclosure of sensitive email data.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway to version 15.1.1 or later immediately.
- If patching is not immediately feasible, disable the Large File Transfer (LFT) feature on internet-facing SEPPmail gateways until the update can be applied.
- Audit system logs for unexpected file deletions or access attempts targeting critical system configuration files.

objects.name: Jackskid botnet command-and-control infrastructure
objects.description:
## Overview

ThreatFox reported 8 new indicators of compromise for the Jackskid (elf.jackskid) botnet. The indicators consist of IP addresses communicating over port 443, suggesting an attempt to masquerade command-and-control traffic as standard HTTPS. Jackskid is a known variant of the Mirai malware family used primarily for distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) operations.

## Recommendation

- Block the identified C2 IP addresses at the perimeter firewall and egress proxy.
- Implement network monitoring to detect outbound connections from internal assets to these specific IP addresses on port 443.
- Review historical logs for any existing connections to the provided IOCs to identify potentially compromised internal endpoints.

objects.name: D-Link DIR-878: Buffer overflow in HNAP Handler (CVE-2026-124562)
objects.description: A vulnerability was identified in the SetWanSettings function of the HNAP Handler component in D-Link DIR-878 version 1.20B05. Manipulation of the ConfigDNS/Primary or ConfigDNS/Secondary arguments leads to a buffer overflow. This vulnerability is remotely exploitable. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The affected product is no longer supported by the maintainer.

objects.name: ingress-nginx: Denial of service and traffic redirection (CVE-2026-116472)
objects.description: A security issue was discovered in ingress-nginx. A user with permission to create an Ingress may be able to cause a denial of service of the ingress-nginx data plane or potentially redirect traffic from other Ingresses. Kubernetes will not be issuing a fix for this CVE because ingress-nginx maintenance ended in March 2026.

objects.name: MIT Kerberos 5: Denial of Service via AUTH_GSSAPI memory exhaustion (CVE-2026-112323)
